---
title: "F-TLP — Time-lock puzzle, verifiable delay function"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 8
---

*F-TLP* (Time-lock puzzle, verifiable delay function) is part of *Layer 8: Time and Application Composites* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

Verifiable delay functions are folded into this functionality, on the same logic as the generic-group merge above (see *G-GG*). The merge is slightly lossy: a verifiable delay function is publicly verifiable, whereas a time-lock puzzle need not be, so this entry understates that distinction.

*References:*

- Baum et al. *TARDIS: A foundation of time-lock puzzles in UC*. In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2021, Part III, volume 12698 of LNCS, pages 429–459, 2021.
- Rivest, Shamir, and Wagner. *Time-lock puzzles and timed-release crypto*. Technical Report MIT/LCS/TR-684, MIT, 1996.
